Description: To raise an existing two-story single family residence by ~ 3 ft., resulting in a residential addition over 14 ft. in average height, in order to create a new ~750 sq. ft. attached Accessory Dwelling Unit within the existing ground floor level, with the separate entrance to the ADU located on the front of the primary dwelling unit, and to reduce the overall building footprint by ~200 sq. ft. in order for the lot to come into compliance with the maximum allowable lot coverage.
